prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED DEEP OCEAN BLUE flat color field — think #1E4A85,
like a classic board-game deep-water tile, like Catan's sea hex or a
Risk board ocean region. The color is RICHLY PIGMENTED navy-to-indigo
blue, clearly readable as DEEP BLUE WATER. NOT black, NOT grey, NOT
dark-wash neutral — a confident saturated blue. Fill the ENTIRE
1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this one blue color corner to
corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border, NO vignette, NO centered
composition, NO waves, NO swell. Only the faintest paint-texture
variation within the same blue hue. A region-fill swatch, not a tile
with a shape drawn on it.
formatted_prompt: Flat editorial game-map terrain tile, saturated region-fill composition covering the entire 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with no border, no frame, no vignette, no centered motif. The whole image is one richly pigmented deep navy-indigo blue (#1E4A85) color field — confident, punchy, unmistakably deep ocean water, like a Catan sea hex or a Risk board ocean region. Color reads as saturated blue, never black, never grey, never dark-neutral. Only the faintest paint-texture variation within the same blue hue — subtle brushstroke grain suggesting a hand-laid wash — while the hue stays fully saturated and consistent corner to corner. No waves, no swell, no horizon, no illustrated elements.
